subject: Request: Legacy Tier - One-time SLA Addendum & Term Reset for Vectorix
messages:
From: Maya Patel <maya.patel@vectorix.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@vectorix.ai
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal — legacy tier concerns & request for addendum

Hi Mina,

Quick context: Vectorix is finalizing our annual renewal but the leadership team is worried about recent latency spikes and a missed SLO during Q2. They've asked us to push for an SLA enhancement and some one-time economic relief to keep us on the legacy tier for another year while we complete a migration to a newer model.

Specifically we need:
- A short-term SLA addendum guaranteeing 99.95% availability for inference endpoints used by our production pipelines for 6 months, with a 1x service credit if missed.
- A one-time credit to offset Q2 disruption (we're looking for something in the $20k–$40k range).
- Flexibility to reset the renewal term to start from the execution date (so we can align with our fiscal calendar).

We're sensitive to precedent but this is a high-priority retention ask — Vectorix is at risk of consolidating with a competitor if we don't move quickly. Can your team advise on whether Redwood can offer the above as a one-time exception?

Attachment: the latest renewal worksheet (vectorix_renewal_P1_v3.pdf).

Thanks,
Maya Patel
Head of Cloud Ops, Vectorix AI
maya.patel@vectorix.ai

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@vectorix.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — legacy tier concerns & request for addendum

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear ask and for attaching the worksheet. We're sorry to hear about the Q2 disruption. I want to move quickly on this.

Vivek and Rishi, looping you in for approval guidance. Summary of Vectorix's request: SLA bump to 99.95% (6 months), 1x SLA credit, one-time credit ~$20k–$40k, and term reset to align with execution. Account health: 3-year customer, ~ $1.2M ARR, current usage on legacy tier (no reserved commitment).

Proposed internal approach (pending exec signoff):
- One-time, non-precedent 10% discount on their next 12-month invoice (estimated ~$32k).
- 6-month SLA addendum (99.95%) with a single-service-credit remedy capped at $25k.
- Reset contract start date to execution with standard termination windows.

If you approve, I'll prepare an SLA addendum draft and a concise summary for exec signoff (DocuSign-ready). Maya: would Vectorix accept a $25k credit and the term reset? That would speed approval.

—Mina
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 17 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal — legacy tier concerns & request for addendum

Team — forwarding Vectorix ask. Quick read: 3-year relationship, $1.2M ARR, churn risk due to infra hit; they need a short-term SLA uplift and an economic concession. My read: high strategic value, low complexity to grant a one-time concession, but finance needs visibility on the credit and the legal team must sign off on SLA language.

Proposal for exec approval request:
- One-time discount equal to 10% of the forthcoming invoice (approx $32k).
- SLA addendum for 6 months to 99.95% with 1x service credit, capped at $25k.
- Term reset to start on execution date; no change to automatic renewal cadence otherwise.

Ask for Laura and Rishi: Can finance/legal greenlight the $32k concession + SLA exposure (up to $25k credit)? If not full approval, what counter would you suggest that keeps the deal and limits downside?

Thanks,
Vivek
SVP, Sales — Strategic Accounts

--- Forwarded message attached below ---
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal — legacy tier concerns & request for addendum

Team,

I've reviewed Vectorix's account and the proposed concessions. Finance/legal are comfortable with a controlled, one-time accommodation given the account size and retention risk. Approved terms below — limited to Vectorix and explicitly non-precedent: 

1) One-time invoice credit: 10% of the first renewal invoice, cap $35,000 (approx $32k expected).
2) SLA addendum: temporary uplift to 99.95% for a 6-month window starting on execution; remedy limited to a single service credit equal to actual invoice value up to $25,000.
3) Term reset: contract start date will be reset to the DocuSign execution date; renewal cadence thereafter unchanged.

Conditions:
- SLA addendum must be countersigned by legal and include a clause that this is a one-off for Vectorix and not a product change.
- Customer must execute the revised order form within 7 business days of the DocuSign envelope being sent, and prepayment for the first 30 days is required.
- All concessions expire after the 7-business-day window if not executed.

Please prepare the SLA addendum and the order form (sales ops/legal templates) and send to Vectorix with DocuSign. CC finance@redwood.ai on the envelope.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

---

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Patel <maya.patel@vectorix.ai>
Cc: procure@vectorix.ai, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 17:18:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Concession approval and next steps — Vectorix renewal

Hi Maya — good news: Redwood can make the one-time exception. Summary of approved concessions (non-precedent):
- One-time credit: 10% of your first renewal invoice, capped at $35,000 (we expect ~ $32k).
- SLA addendum: 99.95% availability for 6 months from execution; single service credit remedy, capped at $25,000.
- Term reset: start date will be the DocuSign execution date.

Conditions: countersign SLA addendum and order form within 7 business days; first 30 days invoiced up front. I've attached the SLA draft (sla_addendum_draft.docx) and the order form for your review. DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abcdef123456 (envelope sent — please review).

If this is acceptable, sign and I'll coordinate with legal and finance to finalize. If you need any small adjustments to wording (not the economic terms), we can loop legal for a single redline pass.

Appreciate the partnership — looking forward to closing and supporting the migration plan you mentioned.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.ai

Attachments: sla_addendum_draft.docx (SLA addendum draft), vectorix_renewal_P1_v3.pdf (original worksheet)
